content: Merere imbuk sua ila ki Abaram
Kaimer to Merere ipet ki Abaram ila miuŋana, mi iso pini ta kembei: “Abaram, moto pepe. Nio ta ko aŋwe siŋgiao pu. Mi nu ko kam lem kadoono biibi kat.”

Tamen Abaram iso: “O Merere Anutu tio, sokorei tabe nu kam pio i? Nio leŋ kelŋoŋ sa? Eliezer ki kar Damaskus tau imbesmbeeze pio i, na ni ta ko ikel yo mi imender pa koroŋ tio ta boozomen. Pa nu kam leŋ kelŋoŋ sa som.”
Mi Merere kalŋaana imar ki Abaram ta kembei: “Som. Mbesooŋo ku tina ko ikelu ma ikam murim na som. Lutum ŋonoono tabe itum peebi gi, ko ikam murim mi imender pa koroŋ ku ta boozomen.”
To Merere ikam Abaram ma tipera mat, mi iso pini ta kembei: “Motom sala mi re pitik ta timbot saamba a. Irao nin? Popoŋana ku kola tipet ma tiwe munŋaana ka tieene kembei ta pitik tiŋga.”
Mi Abaram leleene iurla kembei sua ki Merere ko iur ŋonoono. Tana Merere ire i kembei ni tomtom ndeeŋeŋana.
Mi Merere iso pini mini ta kembei: “Nio Merere ku. Nio ta aŋkamu ma zem kar Ur ki Kaldia, bekena aŋkam lem toono ta tiŋgi.”
Tamen Abaram iso: “O Merere, biibi tio, nu ko kam so mbulu i bekena aŋute kat ta kembei: Toono tiŋgi ko iwe leŋ?”
To Merere iso pini ta kembei: “Kam makau paŋgaara ta, mekmek paŋgaara ta, mi sipsip tomooto ta, ta kan ndaama teltelŋa na, ramaki mbalmbal mi uutu ma timar tio.”
Tana Abaram ila ma ikam zin koroŋ tana ma imar, to isupaala zin mi iur zin ma pakaana pakaana. Tamen man ru tana na, isupaala zin som.
Mi manboŋ pakan ta timar ma tisu ma tisombe tikan buzur tana. Tamen Abaram inaana zin ma tila len.
Zoŋ ikamam be isula, mi Abaram ikeene ma izemke i kat. To zugut mandiŋ kat, ta isu ma izuki. Tabe motoŋana biibi ikami.

To Merere iso pini ta kembei. Iso: “Iŋgi be aŋpaute u pa mbulu tabe ipet pa kaimer i. Popoŋana ku ko tiwe leembe pa lele toro. Mi lele tana ka tomtom bizin ko tikam zin ma tiwe len mbesooŋo, mi tiseseeze matan ma irao ndaama 400.
Tamen kaimer nio ko aŋur kadoono pa toono tana ka tomtom bizin. Mi popoŋana ku ko tiyo len koroŋ boozomen kizin wal tana, mi tizem lele kizin, mi timiili ma timar toono ti mini.
Tamen nu na, mbotŋana ku ko ambai men ma irao we kolman kat, to meete.

Tana wal ku ko loŋa mi timiili ma timar mini pa toono tiŋgi na som. Ko timbotmbot ma molo su lele tabe tila pa i. Pa zin wal ki Amor ta timbotmbot pa toono tiŋgi i, bela tikamam mbulu sananŋan boozomen ma irao kat pa ka kin, tonabe nio aŋur kadoono pizin, mi aŋziiri zin ma tila len. Naso popoŋana ku tirao timiili ma timar toono tiŋgi mini.”
Indeeŋe zoŋ isula ma lele zugut to, you ta ipet mi iyaara ma biibi ila buzur pakan pakan mazwan.

Mbeŋ tana, Merere imbuk sua ila ki Abaram mi iso: “Nio ko aŋkam toono ta boozomen tiŋgi pa popoŋana ku ma iwe len. Toono tiom ko ila tuŋ su yok kizin Aikuptu kezeene, mi ila imap su yok biibi Euprates.
Toono tana na, kizin wal ki Keni, Kenis, Kadmon, Et, Peres, Repa, Amor, Kanaan, Girgas, mi Yebus.”
